written.text: How is the profession of medicine and surgery different from animal husbandry?
written.finalAnswer: Medicine and surgery deal with the diagnosis and treatment of diseases in people and the repair, replacement or removal of defective body parts. Animal husbandry involves breeding and caring for livestock to improve their quality and productivity.

Questions may also ask for the major jobs of a career from the table; match each job to the correct career.

explain.title: Biology opens many career paths
explain.body: After their FSc with Biology, students can select further studies for diverse careers. These include careers in health, agriculture, animal care, plants, conservation, technology and forensics.

explain.title: Careers have different jobs
explain.body: The profession medicine deals with the diagnosis and treatment of diseases. In surgery the defective parts of the body are repaired, replaced or removed. Other careers have different roles: dentists specialize in oral health, and forensic scientists analyse physical evidence from crime scenes in criminal investigations.

explain.title: Careers require relevant study
explain.body: The degree depends on the career. Medicine and surgery require a 5-year MBBS degree; dentistry requires a 4-year BDS degree. Agriculture, horticulture, forestry and biotechnology each require a 4-year BS degree in the relevant field.

explain.title: Biology careers also include animals and the environment
explain.body: Veterinary Medicine focuses on diagnosis and treatment of diseases in animals and surgeries in animals. Environmental Science addresses pollution and natural resources. Animal husbandry involves breeding and caring for livestock to improve their quality and productivity.

mistakes: Do not confuse medicine and surgery, which deal with people, with Veterinary Medicine, which deals with animals.
Do not mix up degree requirements: medicine and surgery require a 5-year MBBS, while dentistry requires a 4-year BDS.
When asked for a career's work, give its specific role rather than only naming its degree.
Do not say animal husbandry is simply veterinary treatment; it involves breeding and caring for livestock to improve their quality and productivity.
